# Wave project concept artwork

Generated with the built-in ImageGen tool. These are illustrative concept placeholders for a gallery layout study; they are not representations of real client projects. All three originals are 1536 × 1024 PNG files. The selected tool-produced images were copied unchanged into this project; originals remain in generated_images.

## concept-campaign.png

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original landscape 3:2 artwork for a VOICE portfolio concept gallery, designed to remain visually strong when sliced into narrow vertical sound-wave strips. Primary request: a tactile Mumbai campaign-print composition, a beautifully art-directed wall of layered paper posters, warm terracotta architectural shapes, small balcony grids and bold teal/cobalt graphic forms inspired by urban chawls. Style: sophisticated editorial illustration mixed with photographed paper texture, not a UI or webpage mockup. Composition: full-bleed wide landscape, strong rhythm across the whole frame, dramatic large shapes with fine tactile details, no empty borders. Color palette: terracotta red, deep teal, midnight/cobalt blue, warm ivory. Lighting: warm late-afternoon studio sunlight and soft paper shadows. Constraints: no readable text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no people, no fake client brands. This is illustrative concept artwork, not a real project.

## concept-editorial.png

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: original landscape 3:2 editorial artwork for a VOICE portfolio concept gallery, legible when sliced into narrow vertical strips. Primary request: a cinematic Mumbai city-story collage, a local train gliding through layered neighbourhood architecture at dusk, tactile ivory papers and subtle map-like linework interwoven with balconies, warm lit windows and a distant teal sky. Style: mature painterly editorial collage with beautiful material texture, restrained detail, no UI or webpage mockup. Composition: full-bleed wide landscape with strong horizontal storytelling and multiple focal details across the frame, the train spans the lower middle, rich visual depth. Color palette: deep teal and cobalt dusk, warm ivory paper, terracotta buildings and amber lights. Constraints: no readable text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no identifiable people, no fake client brands. This is illustrative concept artwork, not a real project.

## concept-design.png

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original landscape 3:2 design-concept artwork for a VOICE portfolio gallery, strong when sliced into narrow vertical sound-wave strips. Primary request: a sophisticated sculptural identity-design still life made from warm ivory paper, terracotta blocks and deep teal forms. A physical undulating sound wave of thin paper fins rises and falls across the composition, with small folded print sheets and subtle cobalt geometric accents. Style: high-end editorial product photography of handcrafted paper and architectural miniatures, tactile and atmospheric, not a UI or webpage mockup. Composition: full-bleed wide landscape, oblique three-quarter angle, large elegant wave rhythm across the whole frame, beautiful fine shadows and nuanced material grain. Lighting: soft warm directional light with deep clean shadows. Constraints: no readable text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no people, no fake client brands. This is illustrative concept artwork, not a real project.
